title: Akiyama Mizuki — A Moment's Rest〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu, what's wrong?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa, you're burning up...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. I'm just feeling a little lightheaded...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
That hardly counts as being okay.
Ugh, there really aren't any dull moments when it comes to you...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Let's postpone this discussion until after Mafuyu's fever breaks...
Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Mafuyu catching a cold...
Can't really say that I saw that coming.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But she has been staying later than me and Ena lately, so she might've been more fatigued than she was letting on...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I hope she gets better soon.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Also, I'm bored...
I'm pretty much done with everything I needed to do today.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I know...!
bgm_area00005
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Now, where did Rin run off to...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, hey, Luka! I'm back...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Welcome, Mizuki.
Oh, what's that you have there...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, this? It's a corsage.
I was thinking that it'd look great on Rin♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. What a cute lace pattern.
Its bright coloring should make it a nice accent piece.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know, right♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There isn't much to work on today too, so I was hoping to give this to her...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Do you happen to know where Rin is, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, I saw her just now.
Would you like me to show you where?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, thanks...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But before I do, let's chat just a little while longer...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You wanna chat...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, sure. Why not?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Thank you. Now then...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Before Mafuyu became ill, didn't you mention how you couldn't wait to see what kind of lyrics she writes for Kanade's song?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Do you remember what we talked about?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I mean, it was so good!
Like K's reached a whole new level!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I can't wait to see what kind of lyrics you write for this song, Mafuyu!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: She's found the key to the door that she's been searching for, but doesn't know where the keyhole is, maybe?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I just don't understand...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I kept running circles in my head thinking about why your song made me smile, Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Something welled up inside my chest that time. That's probably what made me smile.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I don't understand why that happened... I just don't know.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I do...!
I remember.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Your analogy about finding a key but not knowing where the keyhole is really stuck with me.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I actually pondered over that a little after you all left.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Not just about how Mafuyu can express herself, but how all of you might be able to as well.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Really? That might be pretty cool!
Any ideas?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Well, the first thought I arrived on has to do with you...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: With me?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. If I were to describe what you're feeling right now, Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'd say that your door is a much more reserved one, no?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Reserved...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. In such a way that it's able to blend in and cause you to forget that it's even there.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Or rather, it's unable to say what it wishes to and is hoping to be found...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's also afraid that others won't accept it...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: No, wait, there are some...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. It's not exactly fair if you keep changing your statements based on how I react.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, darn.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, it looked like you were trying to drill holes into my head with your eyes just now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I was simply trying to see what lies beyond that smile of yours.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Now I see...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (MEIKO refuses to approach them because of what she believes is the best way to operate...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (But knowing that she won't get any answers simply by asking may be playing a significant role as well.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Thank you, Mizuki.
I enjoyed this little chat.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You're welcome♪
We can talk again later when we both have a little more time.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
But you were looking for Rin, yes?
I last saw her somewhere over there.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Great! Thanks, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
Also...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Please feel free to ask for a little push if you'd like to find a way to move forward as Kanade has.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'd like to help free you of whatever's holding you back.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: When that time comes, I will.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And I'll be looking forward to that moment.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I really don't think that's a good idea, Luka...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I'm already walking a tightrope as it is...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: One bad push and that really might be it for me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, I need to find Rin...
